summary: PSA stopped grading English Mega Hyper Rare Pokémon cards from 26 Nov, because the gold foil can fade or get blotchy over time, even in the slab. That was the biggest collector story of the day by far. On the wallet side, Trust Wallet posted a $55,000 Grail pull on day one of its Collector Crypt packs, and Binance Wallet's Renaiss Gacha kept getting coverage, so in-wallet packs are now a crowded space. Solflare Packs talk was steady and positive: Packs & Chill #3 ran live, people posted pulls and campaign rewards, and one post used $-value framing we should not echo.
